activities.anchor: make a prediction, measure the error
activities.caption: rebuild the backpropagation loop
activities.name: gmBackpropOrder

config.prompt: The universal learning rule, step by step — put the loop in order:
items: compute the gradient of that error with respect to every weight — the chain rule, applied backwards
config.why: Depth is the point: edges into textures, textures into parts, parts into objects — a hierarchy of representations, inherited by every generative family.

activities.anchor: answer the sampling problem with a game
activities.caption: file the mechanisms — adversarial or diffusion?
activities.name: gmFamilyBuckets

config.prompt: Two rival answers to image sampling — file each fact:

items.label: a generator maps noise to images; a discriminator learns to tell generated from real
mode collapse — a forger with one good trick
destroy an image by adding Gaussian noise over hundreds of steps, then learn to reverse one step
start from pure noise and run the learned denoiser, typically 20–50 steps
no adversary to fool, stable training, text conditioning plugs in cleanly

config.why: No adversary means no pathology to exploit — stability is why diffusion was the default for essentially every serious image generator by 2022–23.

activities.anchor: diffusion models just denoise images they have seen
activities.caption: true or false — memorisation and novelty
activities.name: gmMemoryJudge

statements.s: The denoiser is trained to predict noise on corrupted inputs.
statements.why: Generation then samples new trajectories through image space from random starts — the model learns the gradient of the data distribution, not an album.

statements.s: Diffusion models just denoise images they have seen.
statements.why: Typical outputs are novel compositions of learned regularities; the tests (Carlini et al., 2023) found memorisation real but rare.

statements.s: Documented memorisation is concentrated in duplicated training images.
statements.why: The measurable truth sits between the hype and the dismissal — testable, and tested.

statements.s: Both the hype and the dismissal miss the measured truth.
statements.why: Real but rare memorisation, mostly duplicates; typical generation is composition, not recall.

activities.caption: which curve is the temperature's work?
activities.name: gmTempTrace

config.prompt: Temperature scales randomness. Which curve shows the probability mass on the most likely token as temperature (x) rises?
config.why: Low temperature concentrates probability — cautious and repetitive; high temperature flattens it — adventurous. Top-p truncates the tail of unlikely tokens.

activities.caption: call the magnitude — the latent compression
activities.name: gmLatentEstimate

config.prompt: In Stable Diffusion, a 512 × 512 pixel image lives in a 64 × 64 latent. Roughly how many times fewer numbers does the latent hold?
config.why: (512 ÷ 64)² = 64 — an 8 × 8 per-side compression, which is why consumer GPUs can run these models at all.
config.context: The geometry is queryable: interpolation passes through plausible intermediate faces, and direction arithmetic yielded 'smiling' as a vector you can add to a neutral face.

activities.anchor: The capability that made generation a product is
activities.caption: find the faulty line — steering
activities.name: gmSteerSpot

config.prompt: This conditioning summary contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: CLIP learned a shared embedding space from hundreds of millions of image–caption pairs.
An image and its description land at nearby points in that space.
Diffusion conditioned on these embeddings converts a sentence into a target region of image space.
The prompt is a rigid file format — only engineers can steer generation.
Steering is also where failure lives: prompts can be injected with hidden text.
config.correction: The prompt became a programming language: subjects, styles, composition, even camera optics are steerable in natural language.
config.why: Conditioning turned language into a control surface — for images via CLIP and cross-attention, for text via instruction tuning and RLHF.

activities.anchor: The application map has quietly become the economy's map
activities.caption: pair each provenance fact with its role
activities.name: gmDeepfakeMatch

config.prompt: The forgery economy and its defences — pair the pieces:

pairs.right: the 2024 Hong Kong case: roughly $25M conned from a finance employee by deepfaked colleagues on a video call
cryptographic signed metadata attached at capture or generation
verification of the requester, out-of-band confirmation, signed provenance

config.why: The durable defence is provenance rather than detection — the same trust-chain logic the cryptography chapter applied to certificates.

activities.anchor: the model understands what it generates
activities.caption: drag the divider — stored versus produced
activities.name: gmUnderstandingCompare

config.prompt: What the model has versus what it does:

before.label: What it stores
before.text: No referent for 'dog' beyond the statistics of pixels labelled with that word; an autoregressive model predicts tokens, not truths.

after.label: What it produces
after.text: Plausible continuations — the training target — and the plausible can be false: hallucination is a property of the objective, not a bug to patch.

config.why: Whether grounded understanding emerges at scale is the live research question; assuming it has already arrived is how confident systems get trusted with consequential work.
